verdict.rationale: Consensus's first-party docs state that every response includes citations so users can trace each insight back to the original source, which directly matches the verification goal of this story. Supporting docs describe surfacing citable, peer-reviewed sources per paper. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of inline, per-claim citation mechanics (e.g., sentence-level attribution) and independent or hands-on corroboration that every substantive claim is actually cited.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.
